Summary
: The English translation of the Mahabharata: one of the two major Sanskrit epics of India. Besides its epic narrative of the Kurukshetra War and the fates of the Kaurava and the Pandava princes, the Mahabharata contains philosophical and devotional material, such as a discussion of the four "goals of life".
NOTE: this is a Summary Study (retelling), not a full translation.
Alternative spelling: Mahābhārata (महाभारत)
